title: 第1章 生孩子是来不及了！
slug: 皇家县令我每日躺着收税
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“殿下，别往心里去，您肯定是太久没吃东西，体力不支，才……才不行的。”

张宁刚睁开眼，就懵逼到了极致。

我，我怎么会在一个香香软软的少女身上醒来？

又做那种梦了？

“不若您先从奴婢身上起来，奴婢去为您弄点吃的？纵是粗茶淡饭，难以下咽，也好过饿坏了身子呀。”

少女十六七岁的年纪，模样生得娇俏，一双剪水的眸子，满是委曲求全的讨好。

老子什么时候这么禽兽了？

以往我梦里的女嘉宾，可都是姐姐级别的。

不明所以的张宁，下意识做起了俯卧撑，想从少女的身上起来，可手臂刚撑起来，他就没出息地又趴了回去。

略有震感～

“嗯哼。”少女被张宁的重量，砸得发出一声闷哼，却不敢恼，满脸关切道，“殿下，您，您没伤到哪里吧？”

张宁没有起不来的尴尬，只感觉一阵头皮发麻。

卧槽，这不是梦！

这样真实的触感，绝不是梦能有的。

张宁连忙扭头，打量起周遭的环境，糊纸的门窗，灰土的地面，无不说明着此地的艰苦，甚至就连空气中好像都在散发着穷酸的味道。

这是把我干哪来了？这还是国内吗？

就在这时，一股陌生的记忆涌入脑海，张宁神色一变，我他妈怎么就穿越了？

大乾王朝，一个历史上从未听说，但和宋、明两朝颇为相似的封建王朝。

好消息，穿越而来的张宁竟误闯天家，成了大乾王朝的六皇子；坏消息——原主过于魔丸，人嫌狗厌。

甚至连皇帝老子都觉得狗东西有碍观瞻，一道圣旨，将原主从繁华的皇城，打发到这大乾最穷的荒山县，来当县令了。

习惯了声色犬马，锦衣玉食生活的原主，一到这荒山县，感觉天都塌了。

没有大鱼大肉，琼浆玉液也就算了，吃个白菜，你竟然还让本皇子啃菜帮子？

本皇子能受这种鸟气？

于是，原主非常硬气地，一连几天都没有进食。

甚至，为了向跟随自己而来的婢女凝香证明，自己体魄惊人，即便不吃不喝，也没什么大碍，竟强行拉着凝香要做点成人运动。

结果丢了个大脸，一怒之下也不知道是气的，还是饿的，很草率地挂了。

丫够燥的！

Page (1/3)

"Your Highness, don't take it too seriously. You must have not eaten for too long and your strength is exhausted. That's why... you can't do it."

As soon as Zhang Ning opened his eyes, he was extremely confused.

Me, how could I wake up in the body of a sweet-smelling and soft girl?

Have that dream again?

"Why don't you get up from me first, and I can go get you something to eat? Even if it's just plain food that's hard to swallow, it's better than being starved to death."

The girl was sixteen or seventeen years old, with a delicate appearance and a pair of water-cut eyes, full of the desire to please.

When did I become such a beast?

In the past, the female guests in my dreams were all at the sister level.

Zhang Ning, who didn't understand why, subconsciously started to do push-ups, trying to get up from the girl's body, but as soon as he raised his arms, he fell back down without any success.

Feeling a little shake~

"Uh-huh." The girl groaned under Zhang Ning's weight, but she didn't dare to be annoyed and said with concern on her face, "Your Highness, you are not injured anywhere, are you?"

Zhang Ning didn't feel embarrassed about not being able to get up. He only felt a numb scalp.

Damn it, this is not a dream!

Such a real touch is definitely not something you can have in a dream.

Zhang Ning quickly turned his head and looked at the surrounding environment. The papered doors and windows, and the dusty ground all showed the hardship of this place. Even the air seemed to exude the smell of poverty.

Where did this get me?Is this still domestic?

At this moment, a strange memory flooded into his mind, and Zhang Ning's expression changed. How the hell did I travel through time?

The Daqian Dynasty is a feudal dynasty that has never been heard of in history, but is quite similar to the Song and Ming dynasties.

The good news is that Zhang Ning, who traveled through time, accidentally broke into the Tian family and became the sixth prince of the Daqian Dynasty; the bad news is that the original owner is too evil, and people dislike dogs.

Even the emperor thought the dog was an eyesore, so an imperial edict sent the original owner from the prosperous imperial city to Huangshan County, the poorest county in Daqian, to be the county magistrate.

The original owner, who was accustomed to a life of sensuality and luxury, felt like the sky was falling when he arrived in this barren mountain county.

If there is no big fish or meat, let’s forget about the fine wine and jade liquid. Just eat some cabbage, and you actually let me eat the cabbage?

Can this prince accept this kind of birdiness?

Therefore, the original owner was very stubborn and did not eat for several days.

He even forced Ningxiang to do some adult exercises in order to prove to his maid Ningxiang that he was in amazing shape and that even if he didn't eat or drink, it wouldn't be a big deal.

As a result, he was very embarrassed. In a fit of rage, he didn't know whether he was angry or hungry, so he died hastily.

It’s so boring!
